entries.title: q_r is the C2 orbit quotient of q_o
entries.body: Modulo QO_EQ, QR_EQ is exactly the orbit equivalence generated by the two-element action {identity,horizontal-reflection}.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Reflection is an involution and QR_EQ contains precisely the identity or once-reflected QO branch.

entries.title: scalar value descends to a partial function on q_r classes
entries.body: Where VALUE(q,v) exists, the value token is unique and constant over the entire QR_EQ class.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Functionality plus QR preservation makes VALUE well-defined on any q_r class in its represented domain of definition.

entries.title: literal action structure requires a transporter at q_r scope
entries.body: Literal LEGAL/Q_STEP labels do not descend unchanged to q_r classes; the transported action relation does.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The reflection branch changes literal c to 6-c while preserving the transported future structure.

entries.title: promotion factors through q_o but not through q_r
entries.body: PROMOTE is invariant under QO_EQ but is not generally invariant under QR_EQ without retaining orientation/tie context.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Literal center-order tie-breaking is part of the orientation-sensitive view.

entries.title: effect multiset factors through q_r
entries.body: The multiset of legal EFFECT classes is a well-defined q_r-class property.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Reflection bijectively transports columns while preserving effect tokens.

entries.title: rank and remaining semantic depth factor through q_r
entries.body: Support rank and the 42-rank dependency-depth bound are q_r-class properties.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Both quantities are invariant under QO equality and reflection.

entries.title: task occurrence identity does not factor through q_o or q_r
entries.body: No quotient by QO_EQ or QR_EQ is sufficient to reconstruct execution task occurrence identity.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Multiple occurrence carriers may project to the same semantic q class.
QU_dependencies: runtime scheduling/work-distribution QU retained where applicable

entries.title: scalar sharing and occurrence-local control are separable
entries.body: A conforming execution may share established q_r scalar VALUE facts while retaining task-control/provenance state per occurrence.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The shared semantic fact and occurrence-local execution identity have disjoint equality scopes.
QU_dependencies: runtime scheduling/work-distribution QU retained where applicable

entries.title: q_r equality cannot retire a task by itself
entries.body: QR_EQ/value equivalence alone supplies no RETIRED task-control conclusion.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: RETIREMENT requires the execution needed flag under task-control authority, not semantic q equality.
QU_dependencies: runtime scheduling/work-distribution QU retained where applicable

entries.title: task-control changes evaluation schedule, not game semantics
entries.body: Changing ABORTED/RETIRED/SPLIT/CONTINUE state cannot redefine Q_STEP, QR_EQ, OUTCOME or VALUE.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Execution-control predicates are outside the primitive game dependency closure.

entries.title: retirement or split does not negate a semantic value
entries.body: RETIRED or SPLIT does not imply that VALUE(q,v) is false or absent for the task's q.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Control state constrains execution, not the mathematical existence/truth of VALUE.
QU_dependencies: runtime scheduling/work-distribution QU retained where applicable

entries.title: completed q_r values are reusable across later occurrences
entries.body: Once VALUE(q,v) is established, every later task occurrence projecting to a QR_EQ state may consume v without merging occurrence identity.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Value is q_r-invariant while task occurrence remains separate.
QU_dependencies: runtime scheduling/work-distribution QU retained where applicable

entries.title: execution control alone cannot publish exact WDL
entries.body: No task-control outcome is sufficient support for a new exact VALUE assertion; an exact semantic VALUE witness or separately qualified proof is still required.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Control tokens contain no WDL semantics.
QU_dependencies: runtime scheduling/work-distribution QU retained where applicable

entries.title: block cofactors realize finite blocked-cell filtering
entries.body: Any finite sequence of defined BLOCK_TRANSITION operations retains exactly the source residual terms containing none of the blocked cells.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Induct on the sequence; each step filters by one cell, idempotently and commutatively.

entries.title: block-cofactor result depends only on the blocked-cell set
entries.body: For defined finite block-only compositions, order and repeated occurrences of blocked cells do not change the final residual up to RESIDUAL_EQ.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Commutativity removes order dependence and idempotence removes duplicates.

entries.title: guarded own cofactors realize a claimed-cell set action before win
entries.body: For a finite own-only sequence in which every intermediate OWN_TRANSITION is defined, the final residual depends only on the set of claimed cells, not their order or repetition, up to RESIDUAL_EQ.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Guarded pairwise commutation and idempotence extend by finite induction; the definition guard excludes terminal singleton consumption.

entries.title: mixed fixed-polarity cofactors depend on own/block cell sets under guards
entries.body: For a finite composition with fixed OWN polarity on one cell set and BLOCK polarity on a disjoint set, if every OWN step remains defined, the final residual is order-independent up to RESIDUAL_EQ.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Pairwise commuting guarded generators can be reordered to a canonical own-then-block sequence.

entries.title: first win partitions algebraic closure from game continuation
entries.body: The guarded set-action closure of own cofactors stops at the first OWN_WIN; there is no valid ordinary Q_STEP continuation across that boundary.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The algebra is valid only while OWN_TRANSITION is defined, and Q_STEP explicitly excludes OWN_WIN.

entries.title: reflection conjugates finite cofactor set actions
entries.body: Reflecting source residuals and every cell in a guarded finite cofactor composition yields the reflected final residual up to RESIDUAL_EQ.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Reflection is an automorphism of each generator and therefore of finite compositions.

entries.title: finite support increments commute by column multiplicity
entries.body: For any finite sequence of defined SUPPORT_STEP operations, the final support depends only on the number of increments applied to each column, not their order.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Pairwise commutation on distinct fields plus identical-step determinism extends by finite permutation.

entries.title: support-rank increase equals support-step count
entries.body: A defined sequence of k SUPPORT_STEP operations raises rank by exactly k.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Each step adds one; finite addition composes exactly.

entries.title: support multiset commutation does not imply history equivalence
entries.body: Two move orders with the same per-column support increments may have equal final support while differing in mover ownership/residual history and therefore need not be QO_EQ.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Support forgets alternating ownership and residual cofactor polarity.

entries.title: q_o is sufficient to forget prior physical history for ordinary future semantics
entries.body: Once two represented states are QO_EQ, prior physical/history differences not present in q_o are irrelevant to the represented orientation-sensitive ordinary future transition structure.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The future congruence is complete for the declared ordinary-game relation, not for physical occurrence/proof identity.

entries.title: q_r additionally forgets horizontal orientation only under transport
entries.body: Passing from q_o to q_r discards orientation while retaining an exact action transporter and scalar future/value semantics.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: q_r is exactly the reflection orbit quotient of q_o.

entries.title: scalar value forgets additional future structure
entries.body: Passing from q_r to equal scalar VALUE can discard distinctions in legal/successor future structure.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Equal WDL is strictly coarser than q_r in admissible models.

entries.title: identity questions must name the quotient level
entries.body: A SAME claim about occurrence, q_o future behavior, q_r reflection-quotiented future behavior, or scalar value cannot be transferred to another level without a separate implication.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The quotient hierarchy has proved failed reverse implications, and qualified NEI 0.4 forbids lifting scoped quotient equality into another identity scope without separate authority.

entries.title: same scalar value cannot substitute for q in move generation
entries.body: VALUE(q,v)=VALUE(t,v) alone cannot justify reusing t's legal actions, successors or action labels for q.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Value equality is too coarse to preserve future-action structure.

entries.title: same q_r cannot substitute for q_o literal labels
entries.body: QR_EQ alone cannot justify literal-column identity; any action-bearing reuse must transport orientation.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The q_r quotient intentionally forgets horizontal orientation.

entries.title: same q_o cannot substitute for occurrence/proof identity
entries.body: QO_EQ alone cannot justify merging task occurrence, physical occurrence or proof-provenance identity.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: q_o is scoped to ordinary future behavior.
QU_dependencies: runtime scheduling/work-distribution QU retained where applicable

entries.title: effect class is q_o-invariant
entries.body: QO_EQ(q,t) implies identical EFFECT(q,c,e) and EFFECT(t,c,e) for every literal c,e.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: EFFECT depends only on q support/residual content and fixed geometry.

entries.title: effect class is q_r-equivariant rather than literal-invariant
entries.body: At q_r scope, effect tokens are preserved only after applying the identity/reflection action transporter.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Reflection preserves effect but may change the literal column coordinate.

entries.title: promotion is an orientation-sensitive view over a q_r-invariant effect multiset
entries.body: PROMOTE adds the fixed literal center-order tie break to effect information; that extra choice is not q_r-invariant.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: The semantic residual between q_r effect data and PROMOTE is orientation-sensitive tie order.

entries.title: promotion asymmetry is not a scalar-semantic defect
entries.body: Two QR_EQ states may select non-transported advisory PROMOTE columns while remaining exactly scalar-value equivalent.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: PROMOTE is outside VALUE support and therefore may differ without contradicting the q_r value theorem.

entries.title: legal-action evaluation order is value-permutation invariant
entries.body: For a fixed q with a complete represented set of OUTCOME values, any permutation of legal-action evaluation leaves the max/min VALUE relation unchanged.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Finite max/min depends on the outcome set, not enumeration order.

entries.title: any deterministic advisory tie break is semantically safe if it only reorders complete evaluation
entries.body: Replacing the PROMOTE/CENTER_ORDER tie policy with another deterministic permutation cannot change mathematical VALUE so long as it neither omits actions nor changes outcomes.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Ordering is a schedule over an unchanged finite objective set.

entries.title: advisory ordering may change execution trace/cost without changing VALUE
entries.body: Different legal evaluation orders can change which work is visited or cut off in an implementation even though the primitive VALUE relation is unchanged.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Semantic permutation invariance does not imply execution-path or cost invariance.

entries.title: including PROMOTE in scalar cache identity would be a semantic over-refinement
entries.body: PROMOTE can distinguish orientation/tie states whose exact scalar cache identity is already safely QR_EQ.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Adding a non-value advisory distinction splits a valid scalar equivalence class; it is not required for correctness.

entries.title: ordering assertions cannot serve as WDL proof support by themselves
entries.body: EFFECT or PROMOTE assertions, without independent game-value support, cannot establish VALUE(q,v).
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Neither relation occurs in the primitive value proof-support closure.

entries.title: semantic dependency rank is independent of task budget
entries.body: Q_DEPENDENCY rank/layer and remaining semantic depth do not depend on nodeBudget, needed, abort, or NEXT_CONTROL.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Rank is a support/game property; budget/flags are execution-control properties.

entries.title: split or retirement does not mutate semantic q dependency
entries.body: SPLIT or RETIRED changes which task occurrence is evaluated but does not add, remove or rewrite any Q_DEPENDENCY edge.
governing_authority: NEI 0.4 where identity scope is stated
entries.witness: Dependency edges are defined solely by Q_STEP, not by task-control state.
QU_dependencies: runtime scheduling/work-distribution QU retained where applicable

depth_semantics: longest admitted IA-premise chain from frozen explicit A0; rejected assertions are excluded
